tasks.goal: Provider Schema v2 can describe, validate, select, and freeze PDLC, adapted TDD, generic TDD, and native providers without provider-specific controller branches
steps: Replace hard-coded engine metadata with the minimum declarative Provider Schema v2 registry and provider binding resolver
acceptance: Explicit provider selection blocks when unavailable, auto selection falls back only before writes, native mode does not probe external providers, and frozen bindings expose stable fingerprints

tasks.goal: Plan Contract v2 represents controller plus provider bindings and permits multiple bounded provider runs in one finite plan
steps: Migrate plan validation from one engine and one opaque PDLC run to bounded task-level provider bindings with safe waves
acceptance: A complex plan may contain several independently verifiable PDLC-backed tasks while recursive planning, overlapping writes, and unbounded PDLC internals remain rejected

tasks.goal: State Schema v7 persists provider bindings and bounded worker progress with controller-trusted revisions and compatible migration
steps: Add Provider Binding and Progress Receipt v1 state transitions without weakening lease, revision, terminal, or migration invariants
acceptance: The parent can record and render the latest worker milestone, repeated liveness does not count as objective progress, and v5/v6 state migrates without changing frozen task facts
verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -B -m unittest scripts.test_delivery_state scripts.test_delivery_next scripts.test_delivery_progress

tasks.goal: Converge runtime uses provider-neutral bounded execution, visible worker progress, native fallback, finite review, adaptive reporting, and explicit Batch commit authorization
steps: Integrate the new contracts into the controller, review loop, report renderer, worker lifecycle, and Batch preflight
acceptance: Converge remains the only controller, PDLC is optional, long work stays visible, high-risk review remains finite, reports use plain language, and Batch blocks before dispatch without commit authorization
verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -B -m unittest scripts.test_delivery_report scripts.test_reporting_contract

tasks.goal: The v0.11.0 package documents and behaviorally validates the complete provider-neutral delivery flow
steps: Update user documentation and version metadata, replace wording-only checks with behavior tests, and run isolated forward validation
acceptance: README explains provider selection, no-PDLC operation, progress, recovery, triggers, and standard versus emergency delivery; all suite checks and official validators pass

final_acceptance: Converge controls the complete finite loop while interchangeable providers perform only their declared work
Complex work is split into bounded tasks and users can see meaningful worker progress without fake percentages
The suite completes feature, fix, and refactor delivery when PDLC and all third-party TDD skills are absent
Provider, state, review, Batch, reporting, migration, and documentation behavior is covered by fresh executable evidence
decisions: Use native-v1 for this self-hosting upgrade to avoid coupling the Provider Schema rewrite to the current PDLC-specific adapter
Treat T2 and T3 as parallel candidates but serialize writes in the shared worktree under the single-writer lease
Do not add arbitrary provider commands, a daemon, true multi-worktree execution, automatic AGENTS.md mutation, or a new Provider skill
